label: Actual cause and existence-reason source need not transfer CONTINGENCY_1 to the same target
paraphrase: A populated two-world interpretation has an actual contingent base causing and furnishing a #312 circumstance reason for the same target, although the target exists necessarily and has a distinct existing cause at both worlds. In the other world an alternative bearer replaces base as source. Thus the target does not modally require the actual base. The earlier directedNature interpretation is reused: necessary co-presence holds both ways while its source-indexed essential existence requirement holds only one way. These controls separate actual causation, candidate explanation, modal co-requirement and source-indexed essence; they neither refute essential dependence nor establish metaphysical possibility or adequacy of the assigned explanations.
